settings.heroBannerText: Free shipping on orders over Rs. 5,000 · Cash on Delivery available nationwide

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Delivery takes 1-3 business days in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad, and 3-5 business days in the rest of Pakistan.

faqs.question: What are the shipping charges and when is shipping free?
faqs.answer: Shipping ranges from Rs. 200 to Rs. 350 depending on the city. Shipping is free on orders above Rs. 5,000.

faqs.question: Can I track my order?
faqs.answer: You'll receive an order ID after placing your order. You can check the order status (Processing/Shipped/Delivered) on the confirmation page.

faqs.question: Do you deliver to all cities in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Yes, we deliver to all major and smaller cities across Pakistan.

faqs.question: What payment methods are available?
faqs.answer: You can pay via Cash on Delivery (COD), JazzCash or EasyPaisa. Debit/Credit card payment will be available soon.

faqs.question: Are there extra charges for COD?
faqs.answer: No, there are no extra charges for Cash on Delivery — only the standard shipping fee applies.

faqs.question: How do I use a promo code?
faqs.answer: On the cart page, enter your code in the 'Promo code' box and click Apply — the discount will be reflected in the total immediately.

faqs.question: What is your return/exchange policy?
faqs.answer: Within 7 days of delivery, you can return or exchange an item as long as it's unworn and the tags are still attached.

faqs.question: What if the size doesn't fit?
faqs.answer: Contact us on our WhatsApp number — we'll guide you through a free size exchange.

faqs.question: How do I choose the right size?
faqs.answer: Every product page has a 'Size chart' link with exact chest, waist and length measurements.

faqs.question: Do I need to create an account to place an order?
faqs.answer: No, StyleHub supports guest checkout — you can place an order without creating an account.

returns.intro: We want you to love what you ordered. If something isn't right, here's how returns and exchanges work at StyleHub.
rules: Items can be returned or exchanged within 7 days of delivery.
Item must be unworn, unwashed, and with original tags attached.
Footwear must be returned in its original box, undamaged.
Sale/clearance items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged, unless defective.
To start a return or exchange, contact us on WhatsApp with your order ID.
Refunds for COD orders are processed via bank transfer within 5-7 business days after we receive the item.
Exchange for a different size is free — no additional shipping charge.
Items damaged due to normal wear, misuse, or alteration are not eligible for return.

shipping.intro: We ship across Pakistan. Here's what to expect on delivery times, charges, and tracking.
rules: All other cities in Pakistan: 3-5 business days.
Shipping charges range from Rs. 200-350 depending on your city, calculated automatically at checkout.
Orders over Rs. 5,000 qualify for free shipping.
Cash on Delivery (COD) is available nationwide with no extra charge.
You'll receive an order ID at checkout — order status can be viewed on the confirmation page.
Orders are processed within 24 hours on business days (Mon-Sat).
We currently do not ship internationally.
